gloss: to want; to desire (showing signs of)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {欲|ほ}しがっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to want; to show signs of wanting
definitions.explanation: Used to describe when someone (usually a third person) displays behavior indicating they want something.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{欲|ほ}しがって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{欲|ほ}しがる。

examples.english: It's not good to covet what others have.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive verb)

Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}) ending in る
- {欲|ほ}しがらない (negative)
- {欲|ほ}しがって (te-form)
- {欲|ほ}しがった (past)

COMMON PATTERNS:
This is the -⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ form of the i-adjective ⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧. The -⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ suffix converts adjectives describing internal feelings into verbs that describe observable behavior. It is typically used for third persons, as Japanese speakers generally don't claim to observe their own feelings from outside.

⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧ vs {欲|ほ}しがる:
- ⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧ - I want (1st person, direct)
- {欲|ほ}しがる - (someone) wants, shows signs of wanting (3rd person, observed)

OTHER -がる VERBS:
- {怖|こわ}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ - to be afraid (from ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧)
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ - to be shy (from ⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧)
- {寂|さび}し⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ - to feel lonely (from ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧)
- ⟦{嫌|いや}がる→嫌がる：03041_iyagaru⟧ - to dislike (from ⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧)
